deadEnds.why: api.sketchfab.com/v3/models/<uid>/download returns HTTP 401 without an OAuth token. The SEARCH API is fully open and was used to census 257 downloadable station-relevant models (all listed in loginWalled with uid/license/faceCount). Token-free paths all failed: media.sketchfab.com/models/<uid>/archives/gltf -> 403; sketchfab.com/i/models/<uid> -> 404 Not found; no archive.org mirror of Sketchfab model binaries exists. Every Sketchfab binary needs a free account login.
All three answer curl with bot-protection (403 / 403 / 202-challenge) and gate downloads behind account login. No usable token-free path.
Large but overwhelmingly fantasy/medieval/sci-fi game art. Almost no transit-station or modern public-interior content; only generic furniture/urban props were worth taking.
CC0 but the download button is a JS modal pointing at a Google Drive folder that is not curl-enumerable.

지하철 개찰구 / 역 대합실 / 에스컬레이터 / 승강기 / metro gate / airport terminal interior / platform screen door all returned 0 downloadable results. Sketchfab's index has effectively no Korean-tagged transit content. 3D Warehouse by contrast DOES index Korean: 개찰구 returned 10 entities, 승강기 5, 에스컬레이터 1 — those were harvested.
